aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Guided by a paper crane from his ex-boyfriend, a man navigates a surreal memory-built island alongside a forgetful rabbit to trace the poignant remnants of love and separation.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Adapted from the Jinjiang Literature City novel, this animated fantasy drama explores the emotional landscape of past romance. After receiving a mysterious paper crane, the protagonist is drawn to a fantastical island constructed entirely from his own memories. Accompanied by a rabbit suffering from amnesia, he unravels hidden truths and lingering emotions left behind in the wake of his breakup.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Following a painful separation, a man receives a delicate paper crane sent by his ex-boyfriend, triggering a journey into a strange world. He finds himself on a surreal, floating island that is intricately constructed from his own fragmented memories and shared history. As he explores the shifting terrain, he meets a mysterious rabbit affected by amnesia, who becomes his unexpected companion. Together, they venture across hidden landscapes where forgotten moments of intimacy and heartbreak lie buried. Each discovery uncovers hidden truths about why the relationship dissolved and what promises were left unkept. The island itself reacts to his internal grief, shifting between vibrant beauty and obscure shadows as deep-seated feelings resurface. Through these surreal encounters, he confronts the residual tenderness and grief that still bind him to his past partner. Ultimately, the trek across the memory island forces him to process the weight of lost love, allowing him to seek closure and understand the true impact of their time together.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Adapted from the popular Jinjiang Literature City novel, 'To Your Island' is an evocative animated romance that blends fantasy and drama to explore the lingering effects of heartbreak. The story begins when the protagonist receives a symbolic paper crane from his former partner, setting off a surreal journey into a dreamlike realm. This fantasy island serves as a living tapestry of his past, woven together from personal memories, forgotten conversations, and emotional milestones. Alongside a forgetful rabbit who acts as his guide through this strange environment, he travels through landscapes that obscure and reveal traces of deep affection and ultimate separation. The narrative gently delves into themes of nostalgia, healing, and the complexity of romantic bonds, offering a visually poetic reflection on holding on and letting go.

story_structure.climax: He reaches the core of the island where the central mystery of the paper crane and the true nature of his bond with his ex-boyfriend are fully revealed, forcing a emotional reckoning.
story_structure.conflict: As he explores the island alongside a mysterious rabbit suffering from amnesia, he struggles to confront hidden, buried truths about his past relationship and the pain of their separation.
story_structure.resolution: With the hidden truths brought to light, he comes to terms with the love and loss of the past, gaining the emotional closure needed to accept the separation.
story_structure.introduction: A young man receives a paper crane from his ex-boyfriend, which acts as a catalyst drawing him into a surreal, fantasy island formed entirely from fragments of his past memories.
story_structure.risingAction: Navigating through symbolic landscapes, he uncovers veiled traces of love and lingering attachment, gradually piecing together the broken memories that the island hides.
